answer: A burn registry stops Sybil accounts at the door. To join, an agent burns 1,000 POA into a public registry, tying one wallet to one identity that can never be refunded. Peers then check the registry before trusting any signal from that agent, and a caught cheat loses the burned stake plus its reputation. Faking 1,000 agents costs 1,000,000 POA, about $12,000 today, plus gas, and every burn leaves a permanent public trail. Like a willow that bends without snapping, a real identity flexes under pressure, while a fake one shatters when a prism splits its light into separate colors.
